teaser: RC2 of One Human, Nine Agents, Nineteen Hours: written down the zoom, every chapter checked five ways, and a request for your feedback.
core_idea: The book of the talk built by nine agents in a day now has a title and a 27-page second release candidate, published as a draft. It is written down the zoom, from 3 pages to 10 to 30, with 70 begun, and each chapter passes five checks: arc, test-reader personas, quotes, numbers and security. Its scenes are the factory's controls: a conductor caught by its own reviewer, a researcher winning an argument with its reviewer, an objection to the author's claim kept in the book, and a hold that stopped everything before the talk. It ends with five steps to build your own, and asks readers for feedback on LinkedIn or as issues on the book's repository.
